summary:
Probed 8 official/consortium bodies from an Italian VPN exit (Proton AG AS208172, Milan, country IT — verified via ipinfo.io before starting). All fetches below were made with local curl 8.21.0 or local py 3.12.10 urllib; every URL reported here was really fetched by me and carries a measured HTTP status and byte count.

WHAT PUBLISHES A VINE BULLETIN. Of 8 bodies probed, 4 host a periodic bulletin reachable without login, and 3 of those are vine plant-protection/agronomic bulletins: (1) Regione del Veneto U.O. Fitosanitario, (2) Consorzio di Tutela del Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco DOCG, (3) Comune di San Pietro di Feletto, which re-hosts two bulletin series authored by others. The 4th, ARPAV, publishes a weekly AGROMETEOROLOGICAL bulletin — that is weather, not plant protection, and I did not treat it as a disease source.

DEEPEST ARCHIVE — the Prosecco consortium, not a public body. prosecco.it exposes an unauthenticated WordPress media endpoint that returned header X-WP-Total: 173 and X-WP-TotalPages: 2 for search=bollettino. I pulled both pages (1,225,379 + 862,642 bytes of JSON) and parsed them: all 173 items have "bollettin" in the filename, distributed by WordPress date year as 2018:1, 2019:12, 2020:23, 2021:27, 2022:30, 2023:23, 2024:15, 2025:19, 2026:23. That is a nine-season run. I did NOT fetch all 173 — I proved 8 of them individually (2 downloaded, 6 measured), including the oldest (2018-dated, HTTP 200, 44,508 bytes). The remaining 165 are enumerated-but-unfetched and I make no claim they all resolve. Caveat: 173 is the count for the search term "bollettino" only; items named otherwise (e.g. "Curva di Maturazione") are excluded and their number is NOT_KNOWN.

REGIONE VENETO — three seasons, three different transports. Per-year archive pages exist for 2024, 2025 and 2026 only; I fetched 2018 through 2023 individually and every one returned a genuine HTTP 404 (50,391 bytes each). The vine bulletins are delivered differently each season, which is the main scraping trap on this front: 2024 is full text embedded inline in a single HTML page (152,833 visible characters, zero PDF links); 2025 is 20 Nextcloud share links on sharing.regione.veneto.it that only yield bytes when "/download" is appended (I proved two, returning Bollettino_vite_1_090425.pdf at 1,984,877 bytes and Bollettino_vite_20_270825.pdf at 1,271,319 bytes via content-disposition); 2026 is 20 Liferay /documents/ paths, of which only 16 carry a ".pdf" extension — I measured the other 4 and all are real application/pdf. A naive ".pdf" link scraper therefore finds 16 of 20 for 2026 and 0 of 20 for both 2024 and 2025.

A HARD PRESERVATION OBSTACLE. The two Regione Veneto vine PDFs I downloaded are AES-256 encrypted (Standard security handler V 5, R 6, Length 256, StdCF, AuthEvent/DocOpen) AND contain zero font objects with 52 and 41 image XObjects across 5 and 4 pages. They are image-only scans with no text layer. Any text pipeline over the regional corpus will need OCR plus decryption handling. By contrast the Prosecco and Feletto PDFs are unencrypted and carry real font objects and ToUnicode CMaps; from the Prosecco 2025 file I extracted readable text confirming the header "CONSORZIO TUTELA CONEGLIANO VALDOBBIADENE", "13 Bollettino Agronomico del 16/07/2025", and a METEO section citing "Fonte: www.arpa.veneto.it".

AVEPA PUBLISHES NO VINE BULLETIN — a measured zero, not a failure. AVEPA's Plone REST API is live and answering (proven by a 91,280-byte response for SearchableText=bollettino and an 11,134-byte response for Title=flavescenza returning 13 items). On that same working endpoint, Title searches for peronospora, oidio, "bollettino fitosanitario" and "difesa integrata" each returned HTTP 200 with items_total: 0. The 1,299 full-text hits for "bollettino" are payment decrees matching the phrase "Bollettino Ufficiale della Regione Veneto" — the official gazette, not a phytosanitary bulletin. AVEPA does publish multi-year Flavescenza dorata funding calls (2023, 2024, 2025, 2026); those are aid documents and a disease name in a funding scheme is NOT an observed occurrence.

TWO TRAPS WORTH CARRYING FORWARD. First, on AVEPA a URL ending ".pdf" returns text/html at 512,718 bytes; the real 39,829 PDF bytes only come with "/@@download/file" appended — I initially saved HTML under a .pdf filename and corrected it. Second, AVEPA served an identical 612,333-byte React shell for /, /home and /aziende because /aziende 302-redirects to /; equal byte counts across different paths were the tell.

I stayed within the 6-document download cap: 6 files on disk, everything else measured only.

measurements.name: BODIES_PROBED
measurements.evidence: Each probed with local curl from the Italian exit, each with a recorded status/byte count: (1) AVEPA www.avepa.it 200/612333 plus a live Plone REST API; (2) Regione del Veneto U.O. Fitosanitario www.regione.veneto.it/web/fitosanitario 200/47736 and 9 per-year pages; (3) ARPAV www.arpa.veneto.it 200/231315 plus 6 bulletin sections; (4) Veneto Agricoltura www.venetoagricoltura.org 200/6250 (SPA); (5) Consorzio di Tutela del Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco DOCG www.prosecco.it 200/67589 plus media API; (6) Provincia di Treviso www.provincia.treviso.it 200/230575 (site search HTTP 500); (7) Comune di San Pietro di Feletto www.comune.sanpietrodifeletto.tv.it 200/128850 and 200/132308; (8) Condifesa TVB www.condifesatvb.it 200/185758.

measurements.name: BODIES_WITH_BULLETINS
measurements.value: 4 host a publicly reachable periodic bulletin; only 3 of those are vine plant-protection/agronomic bulletins
measurements.evidence: VINE BULLETINS (3): Regione del Veneto - 20 vine issues per season for 2024, 2025 and 2026, weekly cadence read off the published dates (e.g. 2026 N.01 09/04 through N.20 27/08); Consorzio Prosecco DOCG - 173 bulletin items in its media library, roughly weekly through each growing season; Comune di San Pietro di Feletto - re-hosts 7 Prosecco DOCG bulletins and 21 Condifesa Agrinotizie bulletins, all dated 2018. NOT A VINE BULLETIN (1): ARPAV publishes a weekly Bollettino Agrometeorologico Regionale (proven, 330352 bytes) but it is agrometeorological, not plant-protection, and I did not count it as a disease source. NO BULLETIN (3): AVEPA (items_total 0 for peronospora, oidio, 'bollettino fitosanitario' and 'difesa integrata' on a demonstrably working search endpoint); Condifesa TVB's own site (media API returns exactly 1 item and it is an SVG icon); Provincia di Treviso (none found, but its search returned HTTP 500 so this is UNPROVEN rather than established). UNDETERMINED (1): Veneto Agricoltura - NEEDS_BROWSER_RENDER.

measurements.name: MULTIYEAR_ARCHIVE_FOUND
measurements.value: YES - two bodies, at very different depths
measurements.evidence: DEEPEST: Consorzio Prosecco DOCG, 9 season-years. Header X-WP-Total: 173 on the media API; I parsed all 173 items across 2 pages, every one with 'bollettin' in the filename, WordPress date years 2018:1, 2019:12, 2020:23, 2021:27, 2022:30, 2023:23, 2024:15, 2025:19, 2026:23. I proved 8 of the 173 individually (2 downloaded, 6 measured, all HTTP 200 application/pdf) including the 2018-dated oldest at 44508 bytes; the other 165 are enumerated but unfetched and I do not claim they all resolve. SHALLOWER: Regione del Veneto, 3 seasons only - per-year pages exist for 2024, 2025 and 2026, while 2018 through 2023 were each fetched and each returned a genuine HTTP 404 at 50391 bytes. SINGLE-YEAR: Comune di San Pietro di Feletto, 28 PDFs all dated 2018; sibling-year directory probes returned HTTP 500 and the parent directory 403, so other years are neither proven nor disproven. NOT AN ARCHIVE: ARPAV's weekly sits at one fixed filename that is overwritten each week.

measurements.name: BEST_SOURCE_URL
measurements.value: https://www.prosecco.it/it/consorzio/area-produttori-5-2/ (human index) with https://www.prosecco.it/wp-json/wp/v2/media?search=bollettino&per_page=100 as the enumeration route
measurements.evidence: Best on three measured grounds. Depth: 9 season-years (2018-2026) versus 3 for the regional authority. Machine-enumerability: an unauthenticated WordPress media endpoint returning per-item source_url, date and mime_type, with pagination proven via X-WP-TotalPages: 2. Parseability: its PDFs are unencrypted with real font objects and ToUnicode CMaps, and I extracted verifying text from the 2025 issue - whereas the Regione Veneto vine PDFs are AES-256 encrypted, image-only and carry zero font objects. CAVEATS: use the ITALIAN page, not the English one (81 document links versus 3). The consortium is NOT a public authority. For a public-authority citation the best source is https://www.regione.veneto.it/web/fitosanitario/bollettini-fitosanitari (2024-2026 only).

measurements.name: AUTHORITY_TYPE
measurements.value: MIXED - 6 of 8 public, 2 of 8 private; the deepest archive belongs to a private body
measurements.evidence: PUBLIC AUTHORITIES/AGENCIES (6): Regione del Veneto U.O. Fitosanitario (regional authority, the phytosanitary service itself); AVEPA (regional paying agency, ente di diritto pubblico under regional law - its own site states the institutional role); ARPAV (regional environmental protection agency, per its page title 'Agenzia Regionale per la Prevenzione e Protezione Ambientale del Veneto'); Veneto Agricoltura (regional agency); Provincia di Treviso (provincial authority); Comune di San Pietro di Feletto (municipality). PRIVATE (2): Consorzio di Tutela del Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco DOCG - a consorzio di tutela, a private-law protection consortium with ministerial recognition, NOT a public authority; and Condifesa TVB, whose own site footer gives p.IVA 04393860269 and which is registered as a societa cooperativa agricola, i.e. a private farmers' cooperative. Registry/legal-status details beyond what these pages state are NOT_KNOWN - I did not verify them against a companies register. NOTE the layering that matters for provenance: the municipality (public) re-hosts bulletins AUTHORED by the two private bodies, so a PDF served from a comune.*.it domain is not necessarily public-authority content.

blockers.detail: Condifesa TVB's page describes the Agrinotizie bulletin and the weekly Recapito Viticolo Interprovinciale but exposes zero document links, and its navigation contains a 'Portale del Socio' (member portal) plus a members-only newsletter sign-up. Its media API (200, 1998 bytes) returns exactly one item and that item is an SVG icon. The bulletins appear to be distributed to members rather than published; the only public copies I proved are the 21 re-hosted 2018 PDFs on the San Pietro di Feletto municipal server. I did not attempt to reach or bypass the member portal.

HTTP 500, 1313 bytes. The provincial site's own search component is broken, so I could not search it. I found no agricultural bulletin on Provincia di Treviso, but because the search is unusable this is UNPROVEN, not a demonstrated absence. /it/agricoltura returned a real HTTP 404 (1057 bytes); the working root is /index.php/it/ (200, 230596).

Returns HTTP 200 with only 6250 bytes - an Angular SPA shell (title 'myPortal', meta fragment '!', loads /build.js) that is byte-identical for every path including the site root. I retried with local py urllib per the fallback procedure and got the same 200/6250, so this is not a curl artefact. No API base is discoverable in the shell. Veneto Agricoltura is an official regional agency and the Regione Veneto 2025 page links out to its 'bollettino-colture-erbacee', so it is a genuine lead, but whether it publishes a VINE bulletin and whether it holds a multi-year archive are both NOT_KNOWN from a non-rendering client.

Directory listing returns HTTP 403 (253 bytes); the sibling 'Bollettini Consorzio/' likewise 403 (251 bytes). Probing a year-sibling path (.../2019/) returned HTTP 500 (528 bytes) on both series. The 2018 files themselves serve fine. Consequence: I cannot enumerate whether the municipality holds years other than 2018, and I must not infer that it does not.

Not an access blocker - the bytes download fine - but a hard PARSING blocker. Both Regione Veneto vine PDFs I downloaded carry a Standard security handler at V 5 / R 6 / Length 256 with StdCF and AuthEvent/DocOpen (AES-256), and contain ZERO /Type/Font objects, zero ToUnicode CMaps, and 52 and 41 /Subtype/Image XObjects across 5 and 4 pages. They are image-only with no text layer. Any text pipeline over the 2025 and 2026 regional vine corpus will need decryption handling plus OCR. I therefore did NOT verify the disease content of these two files by reading them, and I do not claim to have.

HTTP 200 with content-type text/html and 512718 bytes despite the URL ending in .pdf. A naive collector would save an HTML page under a .pdf filename and count it as a preserved document - I did exactly that once and caught it with the 'file' command. The real 39829 PDF bytes require appending /@@download/file. The same Plone pattern occurs on ARPAV: the bulletin .pdf path returns 221697 bytes of HTML, the /@@download/file variant returns 330352 bytes of application/pdf.

not_known: Whether Veneto Agricoltura publishes a VINE bulletin at all, and whether it holds a multi-year archive. Its site is a JS SPA returning an identical 6250-byte shell for every path under both curl and py urllib. NEEDS_BROWSER_RENDER = YES.
Whether Provincia di Treviso publishes any agricultural bulletin. Its own search component returns HTTP 500, so I could not search the site. Absence of evidence here is NOT evidence of absence.
Whether the Comune di San Pietro di Feletto holds bulletin years other than 2018. Directory listings return 403 and year-sibling probes return 500.
Whether all 173 Prosecco media items resolve to real bytes. I proved 8 of 173 individually. The other 165 are enumerated from the API but UNFETCHED.

How many Prosecco bulletins exist beyond the search term 'bollettino'. Items named otherwise - for example the 'Curva di Maturazione' series visible on the same page - are excluded from the 173 and their count is NOT_KNOWN.

The true issue dates of four older Prosecco bulletins where the WordPress date field and the embedded filename date disagree (e.g. WordPress 2019-04-16 versus filename 20180405, and a 2018-dated item stored under an /uploads/2015/11/ path). I report both and did not resolve which is authoritative.

The disease content of the two downloaded Regione Veneto vine PDFs. They are AES-256 encrypted, image-only, zero fonts - I proved they are real PDFs of 5 and 4 pages but I did NOT read them, and no disease claim from them should be attributed to me.

Whether Regione Veneto vine bulletins for seasons before 2024 exist anywhere. The per-year pages 2018-2023 are genuine 404s on the current CMS, but a prior CMS, a different path scheme, or an offline archive could hold them. I did not probe web archives.

Whether the Nextcloud share tokens on sharing.regione.veneto.it are stable long-term. I proved 2 of 20 resolve today; they are opaque tokens with no derivable pattern, so the 2025 season must be harvested from the listing page rather than by URL construction.
Legal/registry status of the two private bodies beyond what their own pages state. I did not verify against a companies register.
Whether ARPAV keeps a dated archive of its weekly agrometeo bulletin anywhere. I found only a single rolling filename; a per-issue archive was not located, but I did not exhaust the site.
Whether Condifesa TVB's Agrinotizie bulletins are obtainable publicly for years other than 2018. Its own site publishes none; the only public copies I proved are the 2018 municipal re-hosts.
